Nina (Growth): planning social for 'Inference Unlocked: Live' webinar. goal is NA morning + APAC evening coverage. need final copy + assets by EOD. @Diego @Samira can you take? :calendar:
Diego (Content): will do 2 headline variants + 3 short reply templates. prefer stat-first hooks.
Samira (Creative): i'll prepare a static hero + 5s looping GIF for X and a 3-slide carousel for LinkedIn. uploading to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/inference-unlocked-assets :arrow_up:
Jordan (PMM): messaging note: emphasize predictable latency and 3x lower per-token cost in our case study. will add bullets in confluence.
Riley (SDR): SDR routing: i'll own live replies. tagging plan: webinar=inference-unlocked, source=x|li. webhook -> https://hooks.redwood.ai/sdr. escalate if >4 replies from same org.
Nina (Growth): reply templates we want: (1) thanks + register CTA, (2) stat hook + register, (3) demo offer. Diego please draft short variants for X. :memo:
Diego (Content): drafts: "Thanks! Save your seat -> https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_campaign=inf-unlocked"; "Quick stat: 3x lower per-token cost in prod 14 register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"; "Want a demo? DM us or book -> https://redwood.ai/demo". will make X-length edits.
Samira (Creative): assets uploaded: hero_final.jpg, hero_loop_5s.mp4, li_carousel_1.png, li_carousel_2.png, alt text included. preview: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/preview/inf-unlocked
Nina (Growth): cadence: X staggered posts at 08:00 PT, 11:00 ET, 19:00 SGT; LinkedIn at 11:00 PT with carousel. A/B headline on first X post.
Diego (Content): headline A: "Inference Unlocked: Faster, cheaper LLM serving"; headline B: "Ship LLM features with predictable cost & latency". will run 50/50 with tag ab_headline=inf_unlocked and track CTR -> regs.
Riley (SDR): routing doc added: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sales/inf-unlocked-routing. webhook tested.
SchedulerBot: scheduled posts: X 1738160000 / 1738173600 / 1738208400; LinkedIn 1738170000. preview: https://app.redwood.ai/scheduler/1738123456
Nina (Growth): action items: Diego copy by 2pm PT; Samira assets by 12pm PT; Riley webhook/routing verified EOD; Jordan bench bullets EOD. review at 3pm sync. :thumbsup:
Diego (Content): will drop final copy here for quick QA before publish.
Nina (Growth): thanks team 14 keep replies concise for SDR handoff. ping if blocked. :sparkles:
